# Data card

## Synthetic episodes

**Origin:** generated by simulator.py. All values, timings and faults are artificial. No plant, patient or IFE records are included.

**Unit:** one episode with 600 two-second observations. The default 148 episodes produce 88,800 rows.

**Observed sensors:** temperature_c, flow_lpm, pressure_bar, vibration_mm_s.

**Known operating inputs:** heat_kw, pump_pct, ambient_c.

**Metadata:** run_id, seed, split, domain, scenario, time_s.

**Evaluation-only fields:** fault_active, quality_fault_active, event_onset_s. These fields are not predictors. In normal-only fitting, annotations are also checked to reject accidentally contaminated training/calibration frames.

Fault intervals persist until the episode ends. Fault type, severity and onset ranges are deliberately limited. There are no combined faults, maintenance interventions, human responses or real measurement-chain latencies.

**Missingness:** only the dropout scenario introduces NaN deliberately. There is no interpolation of measured sensors. Quality reasons and scoring coverage are exported.

**Reproduction:** the complete configuration, episode IDs, seed streams, package versions and compressed-data fingerprint are recorded in artifacts/manifest.json. Compression uses a zero timestamp to make identical CSV bytes reproducible.

## UCI 447 derived feature table

**Source:** [Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems](https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CW21), by Nikolai Helwig, Eliseo Pignanelli and Andreas Schütze. The original data are measurements from a hydraulic test rig, with cycle-wise component condition labels. The repository lists the dataset under CC BY 4.0.

**Redistributed file:** data/external/uci447_features.csv.gz. It contains all 2,205 cycles, summarized into four statistics for each of nine selected physical sensors, plus cycle ID and the five source annotation fields.

**Transformation:** mean, population standard deviation, range and a least-squares slope over normalized cycle time. No labels, virtual efficiency channels or cycle identifiers enter the predictor matrix. All cycles are retained; the unstable flag is not used to filter the data or as a feature.

**Traceability:** data/external/uci447_provenance.json identifies the URL, licence, sensor selection, transformation, archive SHA-256 and derived-file SHA-256. The benchmark rejects a feature file whose hash differs from its sidecar.

**Known limits:** a single rig; repeated conditions; uncertainty about independence of acquisition sessions; full-cycle summaries rather than streaming features. Some labels are easily separable from these physical measurements. High classification performance should be interpreted in that setting.

## What is not in the repository

No full job advert, employer logo, login token, private email, clinical data or proprietary plant dataset is redistributed. The 76,601,704-byte original UCI archive can be downloaded explicitly, but the repository stores only the derived feature table.
